work.title: Record bounded, privacy-safe telemetry on every stage attempt
work.description: Without a baseline, no change to prompts, context, or skills can be shown to help: a shorter response may simply have degraded the work, and a cheaper stage may have caused a return. Records an optional additive telemetry field on the attempt: skill count and resolved skill bytes, context section count and size, tool and command counts with failures, tool input and output sizes, stage duration, and model token usage when the harness reports it, explicitly marked unavailable when it does not. Counts, sizes, digests, and identifiers only. Part of this is already derivable and must not be duplicated: an attempt carries startedAt and finishedAt, and ManifestTrace already records command traces with an exitCode and a metric type. Telemetry is best-effort and non-authoritative by construction.
acceptance: A completed stage attempt carries bounded telemetry, and a manifest without the field still parses under schemaVersion 1
Absent model usage is recorded as explicitly unavailable rather than as zero or as an error
A test suite asserts that no prompt, response, reasoning, raw output, environment value, or credential reaches the manifest, and it fails when a field is added that would carry one
An injected telemetry failure leaves the lifecycle transition, the stage result, and Ship unaffected
The bounded telemetry survives into the manifest of a terminal Work

result.summary: Plan for bounded, privacy-safe attempt telemetry: an optional additive telemetry field on ManifestAttempt {skills, context, tools, model}, collected once at complete by an injected best-effort collector, harness-reported sections delivered through an optional --telemetry file on complete, 'unavailable' recorded for absent model usage, a structural privacy test net, and schemaVersion 1 parsing stability. No derivable data (duration, command counts) is stored.
result.handoff:
# Plan: Record bounded, privacy-safe telemetry on every stage attempt (INIT-1.6)

## Design

**Stored shape** — `ManifestAttempt` gains `telemetry?: AttemptTelemetry`, defined in a new `src/core/telemetry.ts`:

```ts
export const TELEMETRY_UNAVAILABLE = "unavailable";
export interface AttemptTelemetry {
  skills: { count: number; bytes: number };
  context: { sections: number; bytes: number };
  tools: typeof TELEMETRY_UNAVAILABLE | { count: number; failures: number; inputBytes: number; outputBytes: number };
  model: typeof TELEMETRY_UNAVAILABLE | { inputTokens: number; outputTokens: number };
}
```

Every leaf is a non-negative safe integer or the literal `"unavailable"`. No free strings, no nested free-form objects — that is the privacy boundary, stated in the module doc comment: counts, sizes, digests, and identifiers only; a prompt, response, reasoning trace, raw output, environment value, or credential can never fit this shape.

**Not stored (derivable, per the Work description):** stage duration (startedAt/finishedAt already on every attempt) and command counts with failures (ManifestTrace type command + exitCode). INIT-1.7 derives them on read; duplicating them here would create two sources of truth.

**Collection point** — once, at complete. The lifecycle `finish` transition (src/core/lifecycle.ts:8-16) gains `telemetry?: AttemptTelemetry`, and the finished attempt assembly (lifecycle.ts:101-108) carries it. Start is untouched, so the parser never sees a partial shape.

**Collector** — a `TelemetryCollector` port in a new `src/application/telemetry.ts`, injected as the 7th optional WorkService constructor parameter (after `workspace`, same pattern as `clock`). The default collector computes: context sections/bytes from the runtime `input.json` handoff (top-level key count, byte length — readable inside the complete update callback before runtimeRoot is removed at work-service.ts:586); skill count/bytes via `resolveComposition(stage, manifests, hostCapabilities)` plus byte sizes of each resolved SKILL.md; tools/model from the harness report or `"unavailable"`. Collection in `completeLocked` is wrapped best-effort: a throwing collector drops the field and the transition, the result, and Ship proceed unchanged (acceptance 4).

**Harness channel** — `<stage> complete` gains an optional `--telemetry <file>` flag (stage.ts allowedFlags line 25, usage lines 15-19), parsed by a new strict `parseTelemetryReport` in src/cli/inputs.ts: `{ tools?: { count, failures, inputBytes, outputBytes }, model?: { inputTokens, outputTokens } }`, unknown fields refused, non-negative safe integers only. Absent flag means tools and model record `"unavailable"` — never zero, never an error (acceptance 2). The report reaches `WorkService.complete` as a new optional trailing options argument; `ResultInput` and the result.json contract are untouched.

**Persistence** — src/core/work-manifest.ts: `ManifestAttempt.telemetry?` (line 63-76 interface), fixed-order serializer emits it only when present (238-272), parser keys() gate at line 500 gains `"telemetry"` and validates via `parseAttemptTelemetry` from core/telemetry.ts, which throws STATE_CORRUPT on any unknown field, non-integer leaf, or string other than `"unavailable"`. schemaVersion stays 1; a manifest without the field parses (acceptance 1).

**Wiring** — src/cli/main.ts line 49 passes the default collector with the shipped skills directory and host capabilities; src/cli/commands/skill.ts line 22 exports `HOST_CAPABILITIES` for that wiring (one-line export; INIT-1.4 may land the same export first — whoever builds second keeps the single export).

## Acceptance → file/test map

| # | Acceptance | Files | Tests (src/test/telemetry.test.ts, new) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Completed attempt carries bounded telemetry; manifest without the field parses under schemaVersion 1 | work-manifest.ts, lifecycle.ts, work-service.ts, application/telemetry.ts | T1 complete with collector records all four sections; T2 existing-manifest fixture without telemetry round-trips |
| 2 | Absent model usage recorded as explicitly unavailable | application/telemetry.ts, inputs.ts | T3 complete without --telemetry stores model: "unavailable" (and tools: "unavailable") |
| 3 | Privacy test net; fails when a content-carrying field is added | core/telemetry.ts | T4 leaf-walker asserts every telemetry leaf is a number or "unavailable"; T5 parser refuses unknown/forbidden fields (prompt, response, reasoning, output, env, credential, excerpt); T6 serializer/parser symmetry fails if a string-carrying field is added to the type |
| 4 | Injected telemetry failure leaves transition, result, and Ship unaffected | work-service.ts, support/app.ts (optional telemetry injection) | T7 throwing collector: complete succeeds, result recorded, ship accept succeeds, attempt has no telemetry |
| 5 | Telemetry survives into a terminal Work's manifest | (no extra code; attempts are preserved) | T8 runThrough to ship accept; terminal manifest's attempts carry telemetry |

Plus src/test/cli-registry.test.ts: --telemetry accepted on complete, rejected elsewhere, malformed file refused.

## File set (blast radius)
- src/core/telemetry.ts (new): AttemptTelemetry, TelemetryReport, TELEMETRY_UNAVAILABLE, parseAttemptTelemetry, doc-comment privacy boundary
- src/core/work-manifest.ts (modified): optional field, serializer, parser
- src/core/lifecycle.ts (modified): finish transition carries telemetry
- src/application/telemetry.ts (new): TelemetryCollector port + default collector
- src/application/work-service.ts (modified): constructor injection, best-effort collection in completeLocked, optional complete options argument
- src/cli/inputs.ts (modified): parseTelemetryReport
- src/cli/commands/stage.ts (modified): --telemetry flag on complete + usage
- src/cli/commands/skill.ts (modified): export HOST_CAPABILITIES
- src/cli/main.ts (modified): wire default collector
- src/test/telemetry.test.ts (new), src/test/support/app.ts (modified), src/test/cli-registry.test.ts (modified)

## Verification command
`npm run verify` (typecheck + tests + smoke + --help), per .codepatrol/policy.json.

## Non-goals
- No derived-metric reporting or aggregation (INIT-1.7)
- No storing duration or command counts (derivable from startedAt/finishedAt and traces)
- No raw output, prompt, response, reasoning, environment, or credential storage — structurally impossible under the leaf rule
- No schemaVersion bump; telemetry is never mandatory (no collector injected → no field)
- No HandoffV1 changes, no skill-composition recording on the attempt (INIT-1.4), no docs/protocol.md changes

## Dependency note
Build is gated on INIT-1.4 (blockedBy). If INIT-1.4 lands first, `HOST_CAPABILITIES` may already be exported and `ManifestAttempt.skills` may exist; Build refreshes onto the new base and keeps one export. The telemetry field is independent of the skills field — telemetry computes from resolveComposition directly and does not read attempt.skills.

traces.message: P1 inspection. Baseline 35cace3 does not include INIT-1.4's skills field (blockedBy gates Build only). Current state: ManifestAttempt (src/core/work-manifest.ts:63-76) carries stage/attempt/runId/status/execution/startedAt/todo/finishedAt/result/traces/verificationTarget/verifiedCandidate; the parser keys() gate at line 500 and the fixed-order serializer at 238-272 are the additive insertion points, same pattern verificationTarget used. Lifecycle finish transition (src/core/lifecycle.ts:8-16, 101-108) assembles the finished attempt — the single place a telemetry field lands. WorkService.completeLocked (src/application/work-service.ts:489-601) reads buffered traces from runtimeRoot before the update callback and removes runtimeRoot after, so input.json is still readable inside the update — one collection point at complete covers context size. resolveComposition and listShippedSkills already exist (src/core/skill-resolution.ts:89, src/cli/commands/skill.ts:30), so skill count and resolved SKILL.md bytes are computable today. HOST_CAPABILITIES exists at skill.ts:22 but is not exported. No telemetry anywhere: grep for telemetry/Telemetry across src returns nothing. Derivable data that must not be duplicated: duration (startedAt/finishedAt on every attempt) and command counts with failures (ManifestTrace type command + exitCode).

traces.message: P2 design decisions. (1) Shape: ManifestAttempt gains optional telemetry { skills: {count, bytes}, context: {sections, bytes}, tools: 'unavailable' | {count, failures, inputBytes, outputBytes}, model: 'unavailable' | {inputTokens, outputTokens} }. Leaves are non-negative safe integers or the literal 'unavailable' — no free strings, ever. (2) Single collection point at complete: the finish transition gains telemetry; start is untouched; no partial-shape states for the parser. (3) Derivable data is not stored: duration stays derivable from startedAt/finishedAt, command counts/failures from command traces — INIT-1.7 derives them on read. (4) Harness channel: optional --telemetry <file> on <stage> complete, strictly parsed (unknown fields refused, integers only); absent file means tools and model record 'unavailable' — never zero, never an error. (5) Collector is an injected port on WorkService (7th optional constructor param, after workspace); the default collector in src/application/telemetry.ts computes context sections/bytes from the runtime input.json and skill count/bytes via resolveComposition plus SKILL.md byte sizes. Collection is wrapped best-effort: a throwing collector drops the field and the transition, result, and Ship proceed unchanged. (6) Privacy net is structural: a strict parseAttemptTelemetry with a keys() gate, plus a test that walks every telemetry leaf and fails on any string other than 'unavailable', so adding a content-carrying field breaks the suite. (7) schemaVersion stays 1; serializer emits telemetry only when present; a manifest without the field parses.

storedShape.skills: { count: number; bytes: number } — resolved composition size and total SKILL.md bytes
storedShape.context: { sections: number; bytes: number } — handoff top-level sections and input.json bytes

data.failureIsolation: collector throw => telemetry omitted, lifecycle unaffected
